meta.description: Test vectors for X3DH-PQ session establishment protocol

notes.transcript_description: Binds identities, bundle, and the trailing {version || suite-id || SessionFlags} framing block into session key derivation to prevent UKS attacks and downgrade/LI-bit tampering
notes.transcript_format: H(I_a) || H(I_b) || H(bundle) || DH1 || DH2 || DH3 || PQ_ss || version || suite_id || session_flags

transcript_fields.name: alice_identity_hash
transcript_fields.description: BLAKE3 hash of Alice's identity signing public key (2,009 bytes)

transcript_fields.name: bob_identity_hash
transcript_fields.description: BLAKE3 hash of Bob's identity signing public key (2,009 bytes)

transcript_fields.name: bundle_hash
transcript_fields.description: BLAKE3 hash of Bob's signed pre-key bundle signing data

transcript_fields.name: dh1
transcript_fields.description: X448 DH: Alice identity KEM ↔ Bob OTK

transcript_fields.name: dh2
transcript_fields.description: X448 DH: Alice ephemeral ↔ Bob identity KEM

transcript_fields.name: dh3
transcript_fields.description: X448 DH: Alice ephemeral ↔ Bob OTK

transcript_fields.name: pq_ss
transcript_fields.description: sntrup761 shared secret from encapsulation to Bob's OTK

transcript_fields.name: version
transcript_fields.description: PROTOCOL_VERSION (0x01) from trelis-wire constants — binds the protocol version into the KDF (F08)

transcript_fields.name: suite_id
transcript_fields.description: CIPHER_SUITE (0x01) from trelis-wire constants — binds the cipher suite so a downgrade/strip diverges the derived key (F08)

transcript_fields.name: session_flags
transcript_fields.description: SessionFlags byte: bit 0 = LI-capability, bits 1..=7 reserved-zero — binds the lawful-intercept capability bit (F18)
